concerns.text: T020-trial-exec depends on T023-feasibility-pilot, but T023-feasibility-pilot depends on T020b. T020b (latency validation) depends on T021c (which is missing/undefined) and T022a. This creates a circular or broken dependency chain: T020 -> T023 -> T020b -> T022a -> T020-trial-exec. T020 cannot run before T023, but T023 requires T020b which requires T022a which requires T020-trial-exec results. The pilot (T023) must run on a subset of trials, not the full T020 execution, breaking the dependency loop.

T021b (success metric) depends on T021c and T022a. T021c is not defined in the task list. T022a (baseline runner) depends on T021c. This undefined dependency (T021c) blocks the execution of T021b and T022a, preventing the generation of results needed for T024a-select and T024a-report.

T024a-select depends on T024a-load and T024a-detect-censor. T024a-detect-censor depends on T021c and T022a. T021c is undefined. Furthermore, T024a-select requires the full trial logs from T020-trial-exec, but T020-trial-exec depends on T023-feasibility-pilot, which depends on T020b, which depends on T022a (baseline results). This creates a circular dependency where the full execution (T020) cannot start until the baseline results (T022a) are ready, but T022a requires the test set (T009-serialize) and potentially the symbolic results (T021b) for comparison logic if not independent. The baseline runner (T022a) should be independent of the symbolic pipeline (T020) to allow parallel execution, but the current dependencies force a serial chain that may be logically flawed.

T019c (Decoder Ratio Check) depends on T019b-symbolic-mse and T022b-baseline-mse. T019b depends on T020-trial-exec. T022b depends on T022a. T022a depends on T021c (undefined). The entire validation chain for SC-003 is blocked by the undefined T021c task.

T025-validate-experiment depends on T019c and T019d-constraint-sat. T019d depends on T020-trial-exec. T020 depends on T023-feasibility-pilot. T023 depends on T020b. T020b depends on T021c (undefined). The final validation task is blocked by the undefined T021c and the circular dependency in the feasibility check.

T023b-ci-time-verify depends on T020-trial-exec. T020-trial-exec depends on T023-feasibility-pilot. T023-feasibility-pilot depends on T020b. T020b depends on T021c (undefined). The CI time verification is part of the post-execution analysis but is blocked by the pre-execution feasibility check which itself is blocked by undefined tasks.

T024a-select logic requires filtering censored data for latency tests but including them for McNemar's test. The task depends on T024a-detect-censor which depends on T021c (undefined). The data flow for handling censored data is broken due to the missing T021c task.

T021b depends on T021c. T022a depends on T021c. T024a-detect-censor depends on T021c. T024a-select depends on T024a-detect-censor. T024a-report depends on T024a-select. T024a-validate depends on T024a-report. T025 depends on T019c and T019d. T019c depends on T019b and T022b. T019b depends on T020. T020 depends on T023. T023 depends on T020b. T020b depends on T021c. The entire Phase 4 execution and analysis chain is blocked by the undefined task T021c.

T020-trial-exec depends on T023-feasibility-pilot. T023-feasibility-pilot depends on T020b. T020b depends on T021c (undefined). The feasibility pilot cannot run because it depends on a task (T020b) that depends on an undefined task (T021c). This breaks the logical flow where the pilot should run before the full execution to validate feasibility.

T020b (latency validation) depends on T021c (undefined) and T022a. T022a (baseline runner) depends on T021c. The latency validation cannot proceed without the baseline results, but the baseline results depend on the undefined T021c. This creates a deadlock.
T023-feasibility-pilot depends on T020b. T020b depends on T021c (undefined). The feasibility pilot cannot run, blocking T020-trial-exec. This prevents the entire experiment from starting.

T021c is referenced as a dependency in T021b, T022a, T024a-detect-censor, and T020b, but it is not defined in the task list. This missing task blocks the execution of multiple critical tasks in Phase 4.

T020-trial-exec depends on T023-feasibility-pilot, which depends on T020b, which depends on T022a, which depends on T021c (undefined). This circular/undefined dependency chain prevents the trial execution from starting.
T023-feasibility-pilot depends on T020b. T020b depends on T021c (undefined). The feasibility pilot cannot run, blocking the full trial execution (T020).
T020b depends on T021c (undefined). The latency validation cannot run, blocking the feasibility pilot (T023) and the full trial execution (T020).

T021c is missing. It is a dependency for T021b, T022a, T024a-detect-censor, and T020b. Without T021c, the success metric calculation, baseline runner, censoring detection, and latency validation cannot proceed.
